newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen weak, bargain hunting likely.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen weak, bargain hunting likely.

text.p: Thai stocks are expected to remain weak on Tuesday on lingering concern about the sluggish economy and poor first quarter earnings, brokers said.
But some bargain hunting could emerge today following recent sharp falls in share prices, they said.

"The economy and first quarter results remain a major concern," said one broker at Thaimex Finance and Securities. "But there might be buying interest in some blue-chips as the shares looks quite cheap already."
Most listed companies are expected to announce their first quarter results this week.
The overnight surge on Wall Street and gains in other bourses today may also help boost market sentiment in Thailand, brokers said.

The composite SET index on Monday dropped for the sixth consecutive day and closed at a new 6-1/3 year low after breaking through the psychological 600-point level. It finished 13.25 points or 2.19 percent lower at 592.18 on 3.46 billion baht trade.
